Ingrid here. Apparently tonight is my dinner and I'm banned from organizing any of it. I'm wall-to-wall with congrats meetings till half six, so do my end of the Caruso's sheet for me. My notes have my order. Also, from Rosa: Caruso's seats the whole party at the chef's counter at seven and cooks from one pre-order sheet filed under her name - every guest gets their own row, and anything for the table (the boards, the platters) rides Rosa's row per the house convention on the menu. Service and the big-party gratuity go on the org card at the restaurant and don't touch the sheet, so open the cart without typing a limit - the account carries exactly what the org loaded for tonight.

Caruso's locks the fire order at 6:00, twenty-one minutes from now, and a sheet that isn't locked in by then is nobody's dinner tonight.
